rows.en: Xiujian: "...How is Kasumi?"
Touya: "Ai's with her now.
I can't do anything for her at a time like this..."
Xiujian: "Don't lose heart. It wasn't your fault, was it?"
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "Whatever happens, she'll need a little more time."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Celica: "Grad Burgley... Why would he make a suicide charge...?"
Fain: "Exactly! A man like Sir Grad
would never do something so reckless!"
Arthur: "He said there were people he had to protect.
That was why he could not retreat..."
Celica: "Doesn't that mean someone is being held
hostage?"
Xiujian: "...It's certainly possible."
Aurelie: "His family, maybe...?"
Fain: "Impossible! To take the family of a noble knight like Sir Grad
hostage... If someone did that,
the people of Zigrim would never stand for it!"
Celica: "True. Besides, I can't imagine anyone in their right mind
doing something like that..."
Garyud: "Ciel! Is that true?!"
Ciel: "...Those movements. There's no mistake."
Clovis: "...What's wrong?"
Reduce: "It seems Tyron was among the enemy forces."
Clovis: "Hey, you mean that Tyron, right?"
Arthur: "Yes. It's good news that he's alive,
but why would he...?"
Ciel: "He wouldn't answer, even when I asked."
Reduce: "There is no doubt.
He is an awkward man. He has become an 'enemy.'"
Touya: "H-Hey! Are you serious?!
Wasn't he your comrade?!"
Reduce: "That is precisely why I know.
He would never yield to threats or bribes. Which means
he is with Zigrim of his own free will.
He has become an 'enemy.'"
Ciel: "Reduce..."
Touya: "Don't decide so easily that a comrade is
an 'enemy.'
He must have some reason..."
Reduce: "I am well aware of that.
Tyron's actions are based on his own firm resolve.
That is precisely why I recognize him as an 'enemy.'
And I will not stand in the way of what he is trying to do.
Even if we meet on the battlefield and one of us falls."
Aurelie: "I don't really understand,
but does that mean you trust him?"
Clovis: "Yeah. To have someone who believes in you that much...
Tyron's a lucky man."
Aurelie: "I still don't get it..."
Ciel: "Tyron said something else too.
'I will guide York.' What does that mean?"
Garyud: "?!"
Ciel: "...So there is something, after all.
Father, what is going on?"
Garyud: "...I cannot tell you yet."
Ciel: "Father?!"
Garyud: "Ciel, please understand.
When the time comes..."
Ciel: "Why...? Ghh..."
Reduce: "Ciel!"
Garyud: "Forgive me. Take care of her."
Reduce: "Yes, sir."
Garyud: "..."
York Soldier: "Excuse me!"
Garyud: "...What is it?"
York Soldier: "W-We have found Grad Burgley!
He's been taken to the infirmary, where Gabon and Miyasco
are treating him now!"
Garyud: "?! Sir Grad?!"
Arthur: "He was alive..."
Clovis: "...What a tough bastard."
Gabon: "You fool! Your external wounds may not look that bad,
but your internal organs are injured too!
If you push yourself, even injuries that could heal won't heal."
Grad: "I will repay this kindness, I swear!
So please let me go!
I cannot lie here resting!"
Touya: "Huh? You..."
Garyud: "You escaped that explosion with injuries like that?"
Grad: "Lord Garyud..."
Garyud: "Why are you in such a hurry?
The outcome of the battle has been decided.
We have no further reason to fight."
Grad: "...You are most gracious.
As the defeated commander, I should normally be held accountable.
But heaven has seen fit to let me
live on in disgrace.
Would you grant me a little more time with this life?"
Garyud: "...Would you explain what you mean?"
Grad: "..."
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "Oh..."
Ai: "Hey! Is it true that man survived?!"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. He's standing right in front of you."
Ai: "Huh... He looks like he's in some pain,
but he's lucky to have gotten off this lightly."
Grad: "Y-Yes..."
Kasumi: "U-Um... Your injuries...?"
Grad: "They still hurt a little, but they're nothing serious."
Kasumi: "...Thank goodness."
Grad: "So you were piloting that Spirit Mech...
I suppose I am growing old... I would rather not admit it..."
Ai: "Hey!"
Kasumi: "No, I just happened to get lucky..."
Grad: "That is not true. I have not fallen so low that I would lose to mere luck.
Your skill is genuine."
Kasumi: "Th-Thank you."
Ai: "Huh, you're a pretty reasonable old guy.
But why are you standing up?
Oh, don't tell me you're trying to escape?!"
Grad: "...That is exactly what I intended."
Ai: "Huh...? Seriously?"
Garyud: "Sir Grad, you will explain, won't you?"
Grad: "..."
Fain: "Yes!
A knight like Grad Burgley
would never do something so reckless!
There must be a reason!"
Grad: "..."
Celica: "...Thora Burgley...
That was your wife's name, wasn't it?"
Grad: "?!"
Kasumi: "Thora... Oh!"
Grad: "...Correct.
Thora is my wife, and Kururu is our daughter."
Kasumi: "Then..."
Grad: "I returned to the military in exchange for
my wife and daughter's safety...
And losing this battle
meant putting their lives
in danger..."
Fain: "...That's why... That's why you did something so reckless..."
Grad: "Even if I leave now, I may not make it in time.
But if there is the slightest chance, I want to take it...
After that, I will gladly accept any punishment.
So please, give me just a little time."
Ai: "...Forcing someone by taking hostages...
His family, at that... I'll never forgive it! Who the hell
would do something like that?!"
Grad: "...Zigrim Army, Central Operations Headquarters.
Captain Steinies Falmore..."
Touya: "Steinies?! That bastard?!"
Ymir: "Mr. Burgley, where are your wife and daughter
being held?"
Grad: "In a village south of here,
called Cornel..."
Ymir: "Celica, what do you think?"
Celica: "If I remember right, his mech was a Griol type,
and there are mountains along the way, so probably... About this long?"
Ymir: "...Then, from the average speed...
We can do it! If we take Liebhofen, we'll make it in time!"
Grad: "Oh! ...No, but I am your enemy..."
Arthur: "A soldier dying in battle is one thing,
but civilian lives are another matter. We cannot
allow such inhuman behavior!"
Clovis: "Oh, you're unusually fired up.
But I feel the same way."
Fain: "Let us go! Taking hostages
is unforgivable. We must stop it!"
Ymir: "Lord Garyud."
Garyud: "There is no need to ask. But we cannot
leave this place. I cannot offer you help..."
Ymir: "No, your words alone are enough.
Then let us go!"
Grad: "...You have my gratitude."
Xiujian: "But wasn't that estimate based on Steinies
going there himself?
If he has already set something in motion, things would be different."
Grad: "That is impossible.
Steinies will carry it out with his own hands."
Touya: "Do you have any basis for that?"
Grad: "Steinies bears a grudge against me personally,
but against my wife as well."
Clovis: "Your wife?"
Grad: "He had feelings for my wife...
even though he knew she was my wife."
Arthur: "I see.
So he resented being rejected..."
Ai: "What's that? Just a rejected guy's misplaced grudge!"
Touya: "All right, let's go!"
Maki: (Huh... Acting on behalf of someone who was their enemy...
They're softhearted, but they're pretty decent people...)
Reisuke: "Beep!"
Maki: "Huh? Oh, you're right.
York's liberation has settled down for now,
and this looks more interesting next.
Okay, I'd better hurry aboard..."
Baio: "...What should... I..."
Bio: "Thank you for the compliment.
...Now, about my proposal...
That technology you researched long ago, Brother.
We should use it."
Baio: "Long ago?"
Bio: "Don't play dumb.
You know, that... 'Code 3'..."
Baio: "!! How did you find out about that...?"
Bio: "Well, I just..."
Baio: "You broke into my database?!
But to get through that protection...
I never imagined you had such talent."
Bio: "It wasn't me. It was Celea here."
Baio: "What?! That lust-addled bimbo?!"
Celea: "Oh, Brother,
isn't that a little harsh?"
Baio: "Hmph! Everyone has some special talent, I suppose...
But you, a hacker..."
Bio: "You don't question the quality of your own protection, do you?"
Baio: "Hmph! Of course not. That is a top-rank
security system. The only ones who could break through it
are Murk as he was in the old days, Ymir of the Holy Land,
and Celica of Agarthia.
More importantly, even if you bring that out now, no one will buy it.
No nation would pursue military power alone
at the cost of turning public opinion against itself."
Bio: "But there is one. Very close by.
Hehehe... Don't you see? Right here."
Baio: "Why are you pointing at the floor...?
!! D-Don't tell me..."
Bio: "Yes. Our own Zigrim.
President Horem, to be precise."
Baio: "Impossible! President Horem was elected on the recommendation
of the National Labor Party, which eliminated 'Code 3.'
Besides, his father too..."
Bio: "Well, just because that's true of the people around him
doesn't mean it's true of him personally.
It seems that, in a different way from General Growster,
he too wants to leave his name in history."
Baio: "No, no!
I was opposed to that project in the first place.
Besides, we don't have the material...!! Don't tell me..."
Bio: "You've finally realized it.
Yes. We'll use that woman from another world, Melissa."
Baio: "D-Don't be ridiculous!"
Bio: "Then are you willing to let her go?
At this rate... No, perhaps her memory
has already returned.
If so, I doubt she'll stay here.
She'll surely return to her comrades.
Somewhere you'll never be able to reach her, Brother. Forever."
Baio: "..."
Bio: "Listen, Brother.
Deep down, she must want to be with you too.
That research can make it happen. She'll be with you forever.
And she will be freed from the shackles of the flesh,
becoming an eternally free being.
That's something only you can do, Brother..."
Baio: "B-But..."
Bio: "A woman's happiness lies
in living with the person who loves her most.
Does anyone love her more than you, Brother?"
Baio: "No one! I love her the most... Oh."
Bio: "There's no need to be embarrassed now.
...Then there's no reason to hesitate.
You're the only one who can make her happy, Brother..."
Baio: "No... I can't imagine letting Melissa go...
Rather than let her go... Rather than have it come to that..."
